{{ site_config.box_office.opens_before_show_minutes }} minutes before every show.

- Adults: ${{ ticket_prices.adult }}

- Cinema Club members: ${{ ticket_prices.member }}, every show

## Membership (Cinema Club)

A yearly membership: cheaper tickets at every show, up to $2 off every
popcorn, a free small popcorn in your birthday month, and discounts on
private rentals. Family tiers cover the whole household.
Tiers and prices: {{ base }}/membership/

## Events

- Open Mic: every {{ open_mic.day_label }}. Doors {{ open_mic.doors_label }}, first act {{ open_mic.start_label }}. {{ open_mic.price_label }}, {{ open_mic.audience|lower }}.
  {{ base }}/open-mic/
- Heckle Night: the third Friday of the month, {{ heckle_night.start_label }}.
  {{ base }}/heckle-night/
- Film vote, where the public picks from a short list: {{ base }}/vote

## Rentals, advertising
